description:
PRO BIKE TOOL is a new-age brand that started with the vision of making cycling experience smoother. Whether you're a master mechanic or not – it doesn't matter. Our easy-to-use products are developed to help you with bike maintenance at home. We offer premium quality bike accessories, engineered to precision.

PRO BIKE TOOL STARTED IN 2015, WORKING FROM LAPTOPS AT OUR KITCHEN TABLE

PRO BIKE TOOL was born in 2015 when our founder, Chris, left the safety and security of corporate life to follow his passion for cycling.

Our first produt, the Mini Bike Pump with Gauge, was an instant hit and we sold out before we kenew it! Since then, we've worked continuously to produce a range of effective, essential tools that are useful for all riders. We base our products on what we wish we had in our garage or in our jersey pockets and pour a bit of ourselves into each one.

WE PRODUCE HIGH SPECIFICATION TOOLS AT A VALUE THAT RENDERS THEM ACCESSIBLE TO ALL RIDERS

For us the business isn't just about making sales, but enabling people's adventures and ability to do what they love. We take pride in personally helping customers who have questions or concerns about their purchases and we will always help solve them if they reach out to us. We've learned a lot about our products and made many improvements, often based on feedback from you, our customers.
